notes: The example-health-apis threshold reader HCITDB01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it SELECTs the THRESHOLD row (heart rate, blood pressure) into the COMMAREA. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). sysout is not compared: HCITDB01 DISPLAYs, and the Java side of a CICS run on an estate with no batch package does not capture it (port_blockers P128, fixed by #8246); events, the COMMAREA and the THRESHOLD table are compared. Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived. Not driven: the SQLCODE other-than-0/100 arm ('90', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE): no input makes the seeded table fail.
